title: The Clean Cipher
author: Cyrus Whitlock
blurb: Lena Blackwood, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
